stemMarkdown: A dishonest shopkeeper claims to sell his goods at cost price, but uses a weight of 880 g in place of 1 kg. Find his percentage gain. (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: He charges for 1000 g but delivers 880 g, so on goods costing him Rs. 880 (at Rs. 1 per gram) he collects Rs. 1000. His gain is Rs. 120 on a cost of Rs. 880, i.e. $\dfrac{120}{880} \times 100 = 13.64\%$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Formula: gain $\% = \dfrac{\text{error}}{\text{true weight} - \text{error}} \times 100 = \dfrac{120}{880} \times 100 = 13.64\%$. The denominator is what he actually gives, not 1000.
